services.name: Regular Home Cleaning
services.intro: A thorough, consistent clean of every room you live in: kitchen, bathrooms, bedrooms and living areas, done the same careful way every visit. Book every two weeks and you can stop thinking about it.

services.name: Deep Cleaning
services.intro: Everything in a regular clean, plus the detail work that builds up over months: baseboards, door frames, grout, fixtures, vents, and behind and under what can be moved. It is the visit we recommend before starting a regular plan.

services.name: Move-In / Move-Out Cleaning
services.intro: A complete clean of an empty home, inside every cabinet, drawer and closet, with the fridge and oven included. Built for landlord walk-throughs, new owners and the first night in a new place.

services.name: Kitchen & Bath Detailing
services.intro: A focused deep clean of the kitchen and bathrooms only: degreasing, descaling, grout and fixtures. Ideal between regular cleans, or before hosting.

faqs.q: How is my price calculated?
faqs.a: Your price is based on the service, the number of bedrooms and bathrooms, the type of home and any extras you add. You see it before you book. If your home needs much more or less time than expected, we tell you before we start, never after.

faqs.q: Do I pay when I book?
faqs.a: No. There's no deposit. You pay after the clean by Interac e-Transfer, credit or debit card, or cash.

faqs.q: What if something is missed?
faqs.a: Tell us within 24 hours and we'll come back and re-clean those areas, free of charge.

faqs.q: Do you bring supplies and equipment?
faqs.a: Yes. We bring cloths, mops, a vacuum and our products. If you'd like us to use your own products, or need fragrance-free, add it to your booking notes.

faqs.q: Do I need to be home?
faqs.a: No. You can leave access with a concierge, lockbox or key code. Choose how we get in when you book and we'll confirm the details by text.

faqs.q: Can I reschedule or cancel?
faqs.a: Yes. Let us know at least 24 hours before your arrival window and there's no charge.

faqs.q: Are pets OK?
faqs.a: Absolutely. Tell us about them when you book. For heavy shedding, add the pet hair extra so we schedule enough time.

faqs.q: Why do you wear house shoes?
faqs.a: Street shoes carry grit and salt, especially in a Toronto winter. We change into indoor-only shoes at your door, so your floors only meet clean soles.

faqs.q: Should I book a deep clean first?
faqs.a: If your home hasn't had a professional clean in the last few months, yes. A deep clean resets the build-up so every regular visit after it stays quick and consistent.

faqs.q: Are supplies included in the price?
faqs.a: Yes. Every price includes our products and equipment: cloths, mops, a vacuum and cleaning products. There's nothing extra to buy.

faqs.q: Why do townhouses and houses cost more?
faqs.a: A townhouse or house usually has stairs, more floor area and more entrances than a condo with the same number of bedrooms, so it takes longer to clean. The price box adjusts for this automatically.

faqs.q: Do regular plans cost less?
faqs.a: Yes. Visits every week, every 2 weeks or every 4 weeks cost less than a one-time clean, and you can pause or change your plan with 24 hours' notice.

faqs.q: Is the oven and fridge included in a move-out clean?
faqs.a: Yes. Inside the fridge, oven, cabinets, drawers and closets are all included in a move-in or move-out clean.

faqs.q: Does the home need to be empty?
faqs.a: For a move-in or move-out clean, it's best if furniture and boxes are out so we can reach every surface. If some items remain, mention it in your notes.

faqs.q: How long does a residence walkthrough take?
faqs.a: Usually 20 to 30 minutes. We walk each room with you, note surfaces and priorities, and send a written care plan and quote afterwards.

faqs.q: Can you clean outside business hours?
faqs.a: Tell us what suits your business in the quote form. We'll confirm the times we can offer in your quote.

faqs.q: Do I need a contract?
faqs.a: No contract is needed to start. Most offices begin with a single visit, then choose a schedule.

faqs.q: Which areas do you serve?
faqs.a: Scarborough and North York. Enter your postal code on the site to check. If you're just outside these areas, get in touch and we'll tell you honestly whether we can help.

faqs.q: How do I get in touch?
faqs.a: Email nestnrestcleaning@gmail.com, or send your details through the booking form. Mann replies within 2 hours during business hours.

faqs.q: Do gift cards expire?
faqs.a: No. Nest & Rest gift cards never expire, and they can be used toward any service. Any balance left after a clean stays on the card.

faqs.q: How do I pay for a gift card?
faqs.a: Send the form and we'll text you to confirm the details and send an Interac e-Transfer request. Your gift card is emailed as soon as it's paid.

faqs.q: How does the person I'm gifting book?
faqs.a: They book online like anyone else and mention the code on their gift card. We take the gift value off their price after the clean.

faqs.q: Can the gift be for someone outside Scarborough or North York?
faqs.a: The clean has to be in Scarborough or North York. If you're not sure, enter their postal code on the gift page to check.

faqs.q: Can you clean before listing photos or a showing?
faqs.a: Yes. Tell us the date of your photos or first showing and we'll aim to clean the day before. Evenings and weekends are available.

faqs.q: Does someone need to be there?
faqs.a: No. A lockbox or the concierge works well. We confirm the code by text and delete it after the clean.

faqs.q: How does payment work for multiple properties?
faqs.a: You pay after each clean by Interac e-Transfer, credit or debit card. Each property gets its own receipt, so it's easy to bill back to an owner or seller.
